items.title: An intermediate constant subsheaf of a constant sheaf on the etale site of an irreducible scheme is constant, in the set, abelian group and module cases
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma pins down the constant subsheaves of a constant sheaf on the etale site of an irreducible scheme, in the set, abelian group and module cases (statement lines 12674-12692). The proof is one line (proof lines 12694-12697): the hypothesis fixes the stalk of G at the generic point eta as S', and since every etale morphism U -> X with U nonempty contains eta in its image, the stalk of G over U is the same copy of S' over U; hence G equals underline{S'} throughout. H2: a single density fact drives the three cases.
